# Appendix C: The commands on one page {.unnumbered}

::: {.content-visible when-format="audio"}
This appendix is a page of commands, and it is in the printed edition only. It lists, in the order a round uses them,
the commands for setting up the repo, reading a day's data, backtesting, grid search, stress, validating a file before
an upload, fitting the engine to the portal, and keeping the repo's notes and Rust twins in step. Each comes from the
repo's own guide and the day's runbook, and each flag was checked against the command's help.
:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="audio"}
*Every command runs from the repo's root. `BOT` is a bot file, `DAYS` a day spec (`1`, `1-0`, `1--1`; `all` outside
Prosperity), `D` a data folder or `p2`, `p3`, `p4`. On the day, add `--format qminers --data D` to each command that
reads the day's data, as `RUNBOOK.md` does (not `arena.compact`, the data generators, the sync, the benchmark, the
index or the lint). Flags here were checked with `--help`; `--engine rust` works wherever a tool takes it (not
`arena.validate`).*

**Set up** (once per laptop; the clones are about 2 GB, the tests about 3 minutes)

```sh
references/clone.sh && uv sync && uv run pytest
```

**Read the data** (chapter 3; appendix B; only `premise` needs a bot)

```sh
uv run python -m arena.diagnose DAYS --data D --profile --suggest      # notes per product and a PARAMS entry each
uv run python -m experiments.day.premise --data D --days DAYS --bot BOT  # Prosperity-like or agent-like, per product
uv run python -m experiments.day.structure --data D --days DAYS        # repeats, fixed sums, price grids
```

**Backtest one file** (chapter 10)

```sh
uv run python -m arena.backtest BOT DAYS --data D [--match-trades all|worse|none] [--resting --queue back|prob|front]
    [--delay N] [--fill-ratio R] [--deplete] [--mark mid|touch|last] [--metrics] [--engine rust] [--out results/]
uv run python -m arena.analysis results/                              # charts, fill tables, markouts
```

**Search the settings** (chapters 11 and 15)

```sh
uv run python -m arena.grid BOT DAYS --data D --grid PARAMS.KELP.make_edge=0.5,1,2 --modes all,worse \
    [--holdout last] [--screen 0.25 | --search tpe --budget 1000] [--permute 19] [--scenario rest:resting] --engine rust
uv run python -m arena.compare BOT DAYS --bot python/bots/zoo/claude/*.py --modes all,worse
```

Change a setting only to the summary's `pick` (`RUNBOOK.md`, "Each round", T+1:00).

**Stress, and the market that reacts** (chapters 7, 9 and 13)

```sh
uv run python -m arena.stress BOT DAYS --data D                       # perturbed days; stop_loss about 3x the plain drawdown
uv run python -m arena.sim run BOT --days 5 [--regime trend_up] [--resting]
uv run python -m arena.backtest BOT DAYS --data D --vs BOT            # a shared market, against a copy
```

**Before an upload** (chapter 14)

```sh
uv run python -m arena.validate BOT DAYS --data D --time-limit-ms <theirs> --max-size <the cap> [--late 1]   # exit 1 on FAIL
uv run python -m arena.compact BOT submit/copy.py                     # over the size cap: validate the copy
```

**After an upload** (chapter 12)

```sh
uv run python -m experiments.day.calibrate --data D --days DAYS --bot <the uploaded file> --portal metrics.json \
    --results <the results ZIP> [--vary delay=0,1]
uv run python -m experiments.day.leaderboard_curves --read data/arena/round<N>/leaderboard.json --team <ours>
```

**Before round 4** (chapter 13; the whole command is in `RUNBOOK.md`, "Rules that hold all day")

```sh
uv run python -m experiments.day.standings --rounds data/arena/round{1,2,3}/leaderboard.json --team <ours> \
    --ours <round 4's grid CSV> --format qminers
```

**Other data** (appendix B)

```sh
uv run python -m experiments.abides_days generate --days 10           # ABIDES's days into data/abides
uv run python -m arena.sim generate data/sim --days 5                 # arena.sim's days, Prosperity's layout
uv run python -m experiments.format_drill data/drill                  # the drill format's practice days
```

**Keeping the repo in step** (chapter 14)

```sh
uv run python -m experiments.format_drill --sync                      # after changing DEFAULTS, STRATEGY or EXECUTION
uv run python -m experiments.rust_bench --parity-only --record         # after changing a twin's Python
uv run python -m experiments.ideas_index                              # after editing IDEAS.md
python3 references/wiki/lint.py                                       # after editing the wiki
```
:::
